subject.title: feat(ui): permanent OpenClaw presence — pinned sidebar entry and Settings dock

question: Should the OpenClaw sidebar pin apply only to genuinely new profiles, or to every profile that currently lacks a persisted sidebar-pin setting?
rationale: The current fallback default cannot distinguish those upgrade states, while the PR description promises fresh-profile pinning without silently changing existing users' preferences.

options.title: Keep upgrades unchanged
options.body: Add a first-run or upgrade-boundary path that preserves the prior pin baseline for existing profiles and enables the custodian pin only for new profiles.

options.title: Adopt the new fallback universally
options.body: Accept that existing profiles without a saved pin list gain the OpenClaw pin, document that upgrade behavior, and prove it deliberately.

recommendation.title: Keep upgrades unchanged
recommendation.body: Add a first-run or upgrade-boundary path that preserves the prior pin baseline for existing profiles and enables the custodian pin only for new profiles.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged and proposed work shows direct ownership of the custodian onboarding and UI-flow design, though the protected label still requires maintainer confirmation.
